arguments.summary: Initial investigation revealed that the failed jobs in the database are growing, with 1204 failed jobs as of 12 minutes ago. The read replica is 12 minutes behind, so I am querying the primary database. The nature of the jobs is currently unknown, but I will update the postmortem with details as soon as they are available. The pgbouncer service status is being checked to ensure it is not contributing to the issue.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Check the failed jobs on the primary database to identify the root cause, and monitor pgbouncer for any potential issues.
